name: Chillout Zone VR
summary:
Welcome to a space of respite and tranquility - your getaway from the daily hustle and bustle of education!
 
Discover our innovative solution that revolutionizes the way educational institutions or parents support students exposed to excess stimuli, noise, and struggling with stress and phobias. In our dynamic educational world, everyone deserves a moment to breathe and a space where they can find inner peace.
